theory.title: Habilidad: can, could, be able to y manage to
theory.explanation: Usa can para habilidades presentes y could para capacidades generales en el pasado. Was/were able to y managed to expresan un logro concreto conseguido en el pasado. Will be able to habla de una capacidad futura.
theory.tip: Can = puedo; could = podía; managed to/was able to = consiguió/pudo en una situación concreta; will be able to = podrá.

content.passage: At first, Priya could not use the new design software confidently. She practised for twenty minutes every day and soon became more comfortable. During a difficult project, the team was able to solve a problem that had delayed their work. Priya managed to create the final presentation before the deadline. She still cannot do every task without help, but she knows she will be able to improve with more practice. Her manager has offered her a place on an advanced course.
